note: Corps of Engineers campground beside Pokegama Dam on the Mississippi River, 2 miles west of Grand Rapids; red pine and hardwood woods, a boat ramp, fishing dock and fish-cleaning station. US 2 and a rail line run along the north edge. --Claude
